card.name: Linking words before 'reported' in warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words in label warnings, mostly 'been' or 'has' right before 'reported', and 'and' in lists of conditions. Also 'age' in 'no age-related dosing adjustment'.

modes.label: Been/has before reported
modes.description: The helper word 'been' or 'has' after an adverse effect, just before 'reported'.
modes.example: Hypoglycemia, including severe hypoglycemia, has<< been>> reported following initiation of OLUMIANT

modes.label: And in condition lists
modes.description: The word 'and' joining the last item in a list of heart conditions.
modes.example: especially coronary insufficiency, cardiac arrhythmias,<< and>> hypertension. In a 52-week

modes.label: Age-related phrasing
modes.description: The word 'age' in a statement that no age-related adjustment is needed.
modes.example: and no<< age>>-related dosing adjustment is required. Ca
